theorem: For k equiprobable density operators on a d-dimensional Hilbert space and any k-outcome POVM, P_success <= min(1,d/k), hence P_error >= max(0,1-d/k).
proof_basis: rho_i <= I and sum_i M_i = I imply (1/k) sum_i Tr(M_i rho_i) <= Tr(I_d)/k=d/k.
sharpness: For k=q*d, repeat each orthonormal basis state q times and choose POVM effects |j><j|/q; then P_success=d/k exactly.
pdt_boundary: A same-input PDT prediction above d/k must change the physical state space, effect set, probability law, add side resources/copies, or otherwise modify the microscopic experiment; reinterpretation alone cannot exceed the bound.
novelty: No historical novelty claimed; standard minimum-error quantum-state-discrimination / POVM mathematics.
